text:
noah_pm: Quick sync — we're finalizing retention SLAs for enterprise customers. Two asks from sales: (1) BYOK tenants want 7y retention for audit logs but key delete constraints; (2) compliance customers want per-tenant legal-hold exemptions for e-discovery. How do we model exception paths without creating huge archived key footprint?

sam_security: Short: legal hold + BYOK is tricky because if tenant controls keys and revokes, we can't unencrypt. Options: escrow KMS, customer-driven export, or require consent in contract. We should avoid forcing key escrow unless legal needs it.

maria_prod: We need launch criteria: (a) retention tiers UI + API; (b) exportable audit bundle with chained signatures; (c) legal-hold toggle with retention override; (d) doc for contract language re: BYOK.

ian_eng: Implementation notes: retention enforcement happens at ingest layer. For BYOK+hold we can store ciphertext under two KEKs: tenant key + platform envelope key (HSM-backed). That implies escrow. Alternative: export-only path — on hold, we freeze writes and stream encrypted blobs to customer archive.

claire_ops: SLA implications: 7y cold storage increases egress/restore costs. Need to define 'restore RTO' for long-tail. Also retention-level sampling for logs to support SOC2 audit — can we offer sampling-based long term storage?

sam_security: Regulatory nuance: For ISO/SOC2 we need tamper-evidence and retention proof. Provide signed manifests and hash chains. For GDPR right-to-be-forgotten, tenant key deletion = data gone, can't satisfy 'audit archive' unless we escrow.

noah_pm: Decision needed: Are we allowing full BYOK with no escrow and 'limited' retention (e.g., 90d)? Or escrow required for >1y retention? Proposal: BYOK-no-escrow => retention cap 90d; BYOK-with-escrow => up to 7y.

maria_prod: :thumbsup: I like that. Ops, what's the cost delta?

claire_ops: Estimate: escrow double storage + HSM ops ~ +25-35% OPEX on those tenants. Also operator burden to manage key escrow policies & rotation.

ian_eng: Edge case: tenant rotates keys frequently. If we multi-wrap with an envelope key, rotation is manageable. Will need KMS ACLs and audit trail.

sam_security: We should add launch gating: legal signoff on escrow contract text, SOC2 control mapping documented, and a runbook for key-compromise scenarios.

noah_pm: OK. Action items: @maria_prod draft launch criteria doc by EOD Wed; @ian_eng spike encryption approach and perf tradeoffs (estimations) by next Tue; @claire_ops cost model + restore RTO table; @sam_security produce compliance note for sales. I'll consolidate for the ELT.

deploy-bot: retention-policy-feature branch merged to staging. CI: 12 tests failed (mostly flakiness) — see https://ci.redwood/4567

maria_prod: Noted. Will sync with legal on escrow language. Also flagging customer X who needs 7y by next quarter.

sam_security: Add: include a signed timestamp per archive bundle to satisfy auditors.

noah_pm: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after spikes. If anyone sees a blocker, ping me.
